A '''temple''' was built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]]. By [[137 ABY]], [[Codru-Ji]] held the belief that the spirits of those that had built the structure still haunted it. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the temple was the location of a [[Assassination on Munto Codru|confrontation]] between [[clan chief]] [[Rikkar-Du]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Kruhl]], during which the Sith [[Death/Legends|killed]] Rikkar-Du.<ref name="Legacy 13">[[Legacy (2006) 13|''Legacy'' (2006) 13]]</ref>
